body_lead: AHMEDABAD: Gujarat has launched the AI Green Citizen Score App, a digital platform that tracks and rewards citizens for environment-friendly activities such as tree plantation, waste management, water conservation and green mobility. The mobile app has been developed by Gujarat Informatics Limited (GIL) under the Department of Science and Technology (DST) to encourage public participation in environmental and climate action.
